newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GYPSY DENIED MEAL AT HUNGARY RESTAURANT WINS SUIT.
newsitem.headline: GYPSY DENIED MEAL AT HUNGARY RESTAURANT WINS SUIT.

text.p: A Hungarian gypsy who was refused service in a restaurant in northwestern Hungary has won a landmark discrimination suit against the owner.

Gyula Goman won a libel case against restaurant owner Jozsef Berta of Gyor who had refused to serve him, saying "a gypsy cannot eat, drink or have fun here", the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Thursday.
Goman's lawyer, Imre Furmann, said the case was a landmark for Hungary, where gypsies often are treated as second-class citizens.
